description: Use when the user asks who competes with a company, what a competitor recently did, or for a competitive overview of one or more domains. Input a company domain or name and get a privacy-safe profile: firmographics (business model, stage, HQ, plus `firmographics.funding_stage` / `last_raise` / `investors` / `employee_count` — these read `collected: false` with a plain 'not yet collected' note until that enrichment source is wired up, never a guess), recent strategic moves (the existence of a shift + a was→now summary, with the real analysis date), and links to published reports/comparisons. Returns { covered: false } for companies IndustryLens doesn't publicly track. Pass `companies` (up to 10 names/domains) instead of domain/name to look up several companies in one call — each gets its own result block, in the order given, each tagged with a `status` (account / public / not_covered / ambiguous).

companies.description: Batch alternative to domain/name: up to 10 company names or domains. Omit domain/name when using this. Returns one profile per entry, in input order.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred — most precise.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

name: get_competitive_profile
title: Get a competitive profile for a company
